Anthony Udokwu Foundation Scholarship 2026 (yahweh): How To Apply

The Anthony Ugochukwu Udokwu Foundation has announced the commencement of its 2026/27 scholarship opportunity for Nigerian undergraduates, as well as those awaiting admission.

Anthony Udokwu Foundation Scholarship Abstract

  • Scholarship Host: Anthony Udokwu Foundation 

  • Location: Nigeria

  • Category: Scholarships || Undergraduate Scholarships 

  • Benefits: Full Scholarship

    • Tuition

    • Living Stipends

Anthony Udokwu Foundation Scholarship Details

The Anthony Udokwu Foundation is pleased to announce the 2026 University Scholarship Application.

The Anthony Ugochukwu Udokwu Foundation Yahweh is a non-profit organization devoted to enhancing the lives of those in desperate need.

Interested and qualified candidates are encouraged to read the details we have provided on this webpage, check the requirements, and proceed to submit their applications.

Anthony Udokwu FoundationUndergraduate Scholarship 2026 Benefits

As a beneficiary of the Providence Memorial Undergraduate Scholarship, you are entitled to get;

  • Full tuition coverage for the duration of your studies

  • Monthly allowance (Salary) for your upkeep if you are living with a disability

  • Enrolment in one of the empowerment programs with funding to help you start an independent life while studying

  • Access to a vibrant WhatsApp community where you can participate in various student competitions and win cash prizes and giveaways to support yourself in school.

Anthony Udokwu Foundation Scholarship Requirements

To be eligible for the undergraduate Anthony Udokwu Foundation Scholarship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Be a Nigerian registered undergraduate

Students Living with Disabilities

  • Must provide official confirmation from their University Medical Centre or relevant institutional office.

  • Informal letters or unverified statements will not be accepted.

  • Exception: Clearly verifiable physical disabilities may be assessed without medical documentation.

Orphans

  • Primarily open to students who have lost both parents.

  • Exceptional cases may be considered where one parent has permanently abandoned or disowned the applicant.

  • Claims must be verified by a recognised community authority (e.g. King, Traditional Ruler, etc) using:

    • Official letterhead

    • Stamp or seal

    • Hand signature and date

    • Verifiable contact details and a traceable address

Students Facing Critical Extenuating Circumstances, Abuse or Exploitation

Eligible situations may include, but are not limited to:

  • House helps or domestic workers facing exploitation, coercion, unpaid labour, or abuse while attempting to pursue  education

  • Survivors of rape or sexual violence, where the impact has directly disrupted education or safety

  • Students experiencing physical, emotional, or sexual abuse by guardians, relatives, employers, or authority figures

  • Students subjected to exploitation, including demands for sexual favours or forced labour in exchange for school fees, accommodation, or basic needs

  • Marginalised students facing rejection, discrimination, or systemic neglect within family or community structures etc.

How To Apply for Anthony Udokwu Foundation Scholarship 2026 (YAHWEH)

To apply for the Anthony Udokwu Foundation Scholarship, follow the instructions we have outlined below; 

  • Read the information we have provided on this webpage and ensure your eligibility.

  • Only applications submitted through the official application form will be reviewed.

  • Applications submitted outside the official Facebook page will not be accepted.

  • Shortlisted applicants will be contacted through Facebook Messenger only.

Apply here: www.anthonyudokwufoundationyahweh.co.uk
